1. It is necessary that ye should remain for the present time in
    your places of abode, as it shall be suitable to your circumstances;

It is necessary that ye should remain for the present time in your places of abode, as it shall be suitable to your circumstances ; and inasmuch as ye have lands, ye shall impart to the eastern brethren ; and inasmuch as ye have not lands, let them buy for the present time in those regions round abo
